We've got another day of serious weather forecast here in Leicestershire today, which probably means two things: 1) I will be making regular trips up the driveway To retrieve the black bin. 2) Petanque will be off so I can parcel up the tsunami of Ikea cardboard. Even if they don't open the Petanque club, I don't fancy standing around in high winds and driving rain thank you. We went to Dunelm to order curtains yesterday which was easy - and cheaper than my budget. Hopefully we'll have curtains in about 3 to 4 weeks time. While the front room project is coming to fruition, as usual, it's the little things that become an irritant, and it's at that stage now, but I do feel much more relaxed about it. If you have to go out in the weather today - wrap up and take care of yourself and others. # Today
